scope: Standalone Golden Gradient and typed Color animation in the same generic Inspector.
verified: The Golden Context catalog creates a standalone Gradient. Editing Positions reorders its typed stops, and duplicate and sparse reload preserve the same sampled model.
None switches at the next stop boundary, coincident stops resolve in document order, and Linear and Smooth interpolate RGBA.
Color animation follows current stop edits, clamps out-of-range samples through the target constraints, and preserves stop history and project reload.
A single stop holds its color. An empty gradient and switching to Manual restore the authored color. Undo restores the previous animation subtree.
Nested stop input stays in the same Inspector during double-click and color edits.
